description: 阅读理解：基于课文的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: What could Mike do six years ago?
questions.explanation: Six years ago, Mike could read and draw, but he could not write. 六年前，Mike会读和画，但他不会写。

questions.question: What couldn't Mike do six years ago?
questions.explanation: but he could not write. 但他不会写字。

questions.question: How did Grandpa get news thirty years ago?
questions.questionCn: 三十年前爷爷是怎么获取新闻的？

options.label: B
options.text: By listening to the radio and reading newspapers.

questions.explanation: Thirty years ago, Grandpa listened to the radio and read newspapers for news. 三十年前，爷爷听收音机、看报纸来获取新闻。

questions.question: How does Grandpa get news now?
questions.questionCn: 现在爷爷是怎么获取新闻的？

options.label: C
options.text: He reads and watches news on the Internet.
options.textCn: 他在互联网上阅读和观看新闻。

questions.explanation: Now he can read and watch news on the Internet. 现在他可以在互联网上阅读和观看新闻。

questions.question: What did Grandma do to keep in touch with friends twenty years ago?
questions.questionCn: 二十年前奶奶是怎么和朋友保持联系的？
questions.explanation: Twenty years ago, Grandma wrote letters to her friends. 二十年前，奶奶给她的朋友们写信。

questions.question: What does Grandma do now to keep in touch with friends?
questions.questionCn: 现在奶奶是怎么和朋友保持联系的？

options.label: B
options.text: She writes emails to her e-friends.

questions.explanation: Now she writes emails to her e-friends. 现在她给她的网友们写电子邮件。

questions.question: What did Dad use to call people twenty years ago?
questions.questionCn: 二十年前爸爸用什么给人们打电话？

options.label: C
options.text: The telephone at home and in the office.

questions.explanation: Twenty years ago, Dad used the telephone at home and in the office to call people. 二十年前，爸爸在家和办公室用电话给人们打电话。

questions.question: How does Dad call people now?
questions.questionCn: 现在爸爸怎么给人们打电话？

options.label: A
options.text: With a mobile phone, he can call people anywhere.
options.textCn: 用手机，他可以在任何地方打电话。

options.label: C
options.text: With the telephone in the office.

questions.explanation: Now he has a mobile phone and he can call people anywhere. 现在他有一部手机，他可以在任何地方给人们打电话。

questions.question: How did Mum shop twenty years ago?
questions.questionCn: 二十年前妈妈怎么购物？

options.label: B
options.text: She went to shops and paid in cash.

questions.explanation: Twenty years ago, Mum went to shops and paid in cash. 二十年前，妈妈去商店购物，付现金。

questions.question: When did Bobby's parents buy the robot?
questions.questionCn: Bobby的父母什么时候买的机器人？
questions.explanation: Two weeks ago, Bobby's parents bought a robot from a shop. 两周前，Bobby的父母从商店买了一个机器人。

questions.question: What did the robot cook?
questions.explanation: The robot cooked a big dinner. 机器人做了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

questions.question: What game did the robot play with Bobby?
questions.questionCn: 机器人和Bobby玩了什么游戏？
questions.explanation: The robot played chess with Bobby. 机器人和Bobby下国际象棋。

questions.question: Who won the chess game every time?
questions.explanation: He won every time. 他每次都赢。这里的he指的是机器人。

questions.question: What happened when they came back from the park?
questions.questionCn: 他们从公园回来时发生了什么？

options.label: A
options.text: The robot cooked a delicious dinner.
options.textCn: 机器人做了一顿美味的晚餐。

options.label: B
options.text: The robot was on the floor and didn't work.
options.textCn: 机器人在地板上，不工作了。

options.label: D
options.text: The robot went to the park too.

questions.explanation: The robot was on the floor. It didn't work. 机器人躺在地板上，它不工作了。

questions.question: What is the main idea of this unit?
questions.questionCn: 这个单元的主旨是什么？

options.label: A
options.text: Robots are very smart and can do everything.
options.textCn: 机器人非常聪明，可以做任何事情。

options.label: B
options.text: Life in the past was better than now.

options.label: C
options.text: Technology changes our life, and many things are different from the past.
options.textCn: 科技改变了我们的生活，很多事情和过去不一样了。

options.label: D
options.text: We should not use new technology.
options.textCn: 我们不应该使用新技术。

questions.explanation: 单元主题是「Then and now（过去与现在）」，通过Mike一家生活的变化和Bobby家机器人的故事，告诉我们科技发展给生活带来了巨大的变化，很多事情和过去都不一样了。
